trace.question: What percentage of clients who opened their accounts in the district with an average salary of over 10000 are women?
trace.evidence: Female refers to gender = 'F'; Woman and female are closed; Average salary can be found in A11

attempts.sql:
WITH qualifying_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
    WHERE di.A11 > 10000
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM qualifying_clients
